name: Landing page that converts
blurb: From offer to a live page: copy, design direction, the build, search basics, speed checks and deploy.
description: Plan, write, design, build and ship a landing page that converts from one request: the offer and copy, a design direction, the build, on-page SEO and schema, speed and accessibility checks, then deploy, using the Skill Garden content-creation, website-building, frontend-ui-design and seo super skills in order. Use when asked to make a landing page, sales page, waitlist page or product page for a launch.
ask: Build a landing page for <product or offer>, aimed at <audience>, that gets them to <action>.
inputs: The offer and the one action the page asks for
Who it is for and their biggest objection
Proof you can use: numbers, customers, quotes you have permission to show
Brand assets: logo, colours, fonts, screenshots
Where it will be hosted and any stack you already use

steps.title: Plan the page and write the copy
steps.output: Section-by-section copy: headline, proof, objections answered and one call to action.

steps.title: Pick the design direction
steps.output: A one-line Design Read, the tokens (colour, type, spacing) and a wireframe per section.

steps.title: Build the page
steps.output: The working page in the stack that fits, with every state, responsive from 320 px.

steps.title: Search basics and schema
steps.output: Title, description, headings, a social share image, JSON-LD and a sitemap.

steps.title: Speed, accessibility and anti-slop check
steps.output: Core Web Vitals in the green, an accessibility pass and the fixes made.

steps.title: Deploy
steps.output: The live URL with the domain and analytics set up, and how to roll back.
